secondary_factors: Fintech/software de-risking. Consumer finance exposure via Credit Karma in worsening macro

The 4.0% drop looks mostly like COVID-driven multiple compression with some added M&A overhang.

secondary_factors: Global packaged-food with meaningful international exposure. Supply-chain FX and emerging-market disruption risk

secondary_factors: Spillover from MSFT Feb 26 warning. Lingering skepticism around IBM growth profile post-Red Hat

secondary_factors: Global markets exposure and concern over capital-markets activity weakening
store_description: Citigroup's 5.5% drop was larger than the index and fits the heavy punishment banks took as investors rapidly repriced the path of policy rates and credit costs.

secondary_factors: Fear of ETF/fund outflows and lower fee revenue if volatility persisted
store_description: BLK's 6.4% decline was severe but makes sense mechanically. When global equity markets plunge expected fee-bearing assets and performance-related economics get marked down almost immediately.
